defs.def: a belief that sth you want will happen 希望；期望

ex.s: Emily Sanders, a 25-year-old from Detroit, Michigan, set out on December 23rd with high hopes of reaching Toronto to meet her boyfriend for Christmas.
ex.t: 来自密歇根州底特律的25岁女孩Emily Sanders在12月23日出发，满怀希望前往多伦多见男友过圣诞节。

ex.s: Seeing no hope of immediate rescue, Emily decided to spend the night in her car.
ex.t: 眼看没有立即获救的希望，Emily决定在车里过夜。

ex.s: It helps them live in hope.
ex.t: 它帮助他们生活在希望中。

ex.s: When Sonja Detrinidad opened her online shop selling houseplants, she didn’t have high hopes for it.
ex.t: 当索妮娅·德特里尼达开设了她的在线室内植物店时，她对此并没有抱太大期望。

ex.s: “Our hope is to have a clean, attractant-free place where bears can pass through without learning bad habits,“ says James Jonkel, longtime biologist who manages bears in and around Missoula.
ex.t: 我们的希望是拥有一个干净、无诱饵的地方，让熊可以穿行而过而不养成坏习惯，长期在米苏拉及周边管理熊的生物学家詹姆斯·琼克尔说。

ex.s: Solar Energy: Hope for the Future
ex.t: 太阳能：未来的希望

ex.s: Although the continuing popular appeal of emotional intelligence is desirable, we hope that such attention will excite a greater interest in the scientific and scholarly study of emotion.
ex.t: 尽管情商持续的大众吸引力是可取的，我们希望这种关注能激发对情绪科学和学术研究的更大兴趣。

ex.s: Jordan said that no matter how it ends, it starts with hope.
ex.t: 约旦说，无论结局如何，都以希望为起点。

ex.s: In the incurable form of hope.
ex.t: 以一种无可救药的希望形式。

ex.s: I am an active playgoer and play-reader, and perhaps my best reason for editing this book is a hope of sharing my enthusiasm for the theater with others.
ex.t: 我是一个活跃的游戏爱好者和游戏阅读者，也许我编辑这本书的最佳原因是希望与其他人分享我对剧院的热情。

ex.s: “Painters, sculptors—they've all tried to make the best of this ordinary face, but I'm afraid there's not much hope.
ex.t: “画家、雕塑家——他们都试图把这张普通的脸塑造到最好，但我怕希望不大。”

ex.s: “I gave up hope of finding my ring again," she says.
ex.t: "我已经放弃找到我的戒指的希望了，"她说。

ex.s: She hoped to  44   her message of hope and awareness.
ex.t: 她希望有44条希望和认识的信息。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

defs.def: something that you wish for 希望的东西；期望的事情

ex.s: English flag as a symbol of hope.
ex.t: 英国国旗作为希望的象征。

ex.s: However, instead of the brownish red hair she had hoped for, she final got purple hair.
ex.t: 然而，她最终得到的不是她希望的红棕色头发，而是紫色的头发。

ex.s: I’ve learned a few things along the way though, which I hope you’ll find encouraging if you’re doing your best to figure out how you can make the change in a not-always-supportive household.
ex.t: 不过，在这一过程中我学到了一些东西，如果你正努力在一个并非总是支持你的家庭里弄清楚如何做出改变，我希望这些能给你鼓励。

defs.def: a person, a thing or a situation that will help you get what you want 被寄予希望的人（或事物、情况）

ex.s: made up his mind to runD. lost hope
ex.t: 赢家是一个付出巨大努力的人。

defs.def: to want sth to happen and think that it is possible 希望；期盼

ex.s: Hoping to impress some talented actors to come and work for me for nothing, I spread some throws over the sofas and lit candles to make it seem a bit more “young professional”.
ex.t: 为了给一些有才华的演员留下印象、让他们免费来为我工作，我在沙发上铺了些盖毯、点了蜡烛，让地方显得更“年轻职业范儿”一些。

ex.s: I found it difficult, but still hoped to pass.
ex.t: 我觉得很难，但仍希望能通过。

ex.s: One day, he talked with me or hoped to mend our relations.
ex.t: 有一天，他和我交谈，希望能修复我们的关系。

ex.s: And hopes this can inspire more thinking on the topic!
ex.t: 并希望这能激发更多关于这个话题的思考！

ex.s: “Only if we discuss the consequences of our biophysical limits” the December warning letter says, “can we have the hope to reduce their speed, severity and harm”.
ex.t: "只有当我们讨论我们生物物理极限的后果时"12月的警告信说"我们才有希望降低其速度、严重性和危害"。

ex.s: in the future，the team hopes to develop a version of the technology that can be sprayed onto plant leaves in a one-off treatment that would last the plant’s lifetime.
ex.t: 未来，该团队希望开发一种技术版本，可以一次性喷洒到植物叶片上，效果持续植物一生。

ex.s: Now he hopes that other cities will consider making their streets run smarter instead of just making them bigger.
ex.t: 现在，他希望其他城市能够考虑让它们的街道变得更智能，而不仅仅是让它们变得更大。

ex.s: The team hopes to make it to market in the near future.
ex.t: 该团队希望在不久的将来将其推向市场。

ex.s: “If it had been my dog, I’d hope that somebody would be   60   to go that extra mile.”
ex.t: “如果是我的狗，我希望有人愿意____60____多跑那一程。”

ex.s: She hopes that every kid can have a clean mouth and a broad smile.
ex.t: 她希望每个孩子都能拥有干净的嘴和灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: He fears the worst, but hopes for the best
ex.t: 他做最坏的打算，但抱最好的希望。

ex.s: As the Kennedy Center’s artistic adviser for jazz, Moran hopes to widen the audience for jazz, make the music more accessible, and preserve its history and culture.
ex.t: 作为肯尼迪中心的爵士乐艺术顾问，莫兰希望扩大爵士乐的听众群，让这种音乐更容易被人接受，并保护其历史和文化。

ex.s: “What I’m hoping to accomplish is that my generation and younger start to reconsider and understand that jazz is not black and write anymore.
ex.t: 我希望实现的是，我们这一代和更年轻的一代开始重新思考并理解，爵士乐不再是非黑即白的了。

ex.s: They hoped that wolves would be able to control the elk and coyote problems.
ex.t: 他们希望狼能够控制麋鹿和土狼的问题。

ex.s: What does bill hope to do about his family?
ex.t: 比尔希望为他的家庭做些什么？

ex.s: He hoped to show them this beautiful place someday.
ex.t: 他希望有一天能向他们展示这个美丽的地方。

ex.s: They hope paper bags will be banned someday too and want shoppers to use the same reusable bags for years.
ex.t: 他们希望有一天纸袋也会被禁，并希望购物者多年来一直使用同一个可重复使用的袋子。

ex.s: I hope to understand more next time.
ex.t: 我希望下次能理解更多。

ex.s: Hope to hear from you soon.
ex.t: 希望很快收到你的来信。

ex.s: We hope that you will consider...
ex.t: 我们希望你能考虑……

ex.s: You hope to spread the Chinese dragon boat culture to the world.
ex.t: 你希望将中国的龙舟文化传播到全世界。

ex.s: What do the scientists at Salk Institute hope to achieve?
ex.t: 萨尔克研究所的科学家们希望实现什么？

ex.s: Ask the tourists from around the world that flood into Yellowstone National Park what they most hope to see, and their answer is often the same: a grizzly bear.
ex.t: 向来自世界各地的游客询问淹没进入黄石国家公园的游客最希望看到什么，他们的答案往往是一样的：一只灰熊。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

ex.s: Are you hoping that eventually you will feel empowered because your life is better than theirs?
ex.t: 你是否希望，因为自己的生活比他们好，你最终会感到更有力量？

ex.s: He added that he hopes people in other cities might try similar projects and post their own videos on the Internet.
ex.t: 他补充说，他希望其他城市的居民也尝试类似项目，并在网上发布自己的视频。

ex.s: What do researchers hope to do for older drivers?
ex.t: 研究人员希望能为老年驾驶员做些什么？

ex.s: Bertocchini agrees and hopes her team’s findings might one day help employ the enzyme to break down plastics in landfills.
ex.t: 贝尔托基尼对此表示同意，并希望她团队的发现有朝一日能利用这种酶分解垃圾填埋场中的塑料。

ex.s: Von Wong hopes that his work will also help pressure big companies to reduce their plastic footprint.
ex.t: Von Wong希望他的作品也能推动大公司减少塑料足迹。

ex.s: Led by Professor Phil Blythe, the Newcastle team are developing in-vehicle technologies for older drivers which they hope could help them to continue driving into later life.
ex.t: 在菲尔·布莱斯教授的领导下，纽卡斯尔团队正在为老年驾驶员开发车载技术，他们希望这些技术能帮助他们在晚年继续驾驶。

ex.s: Were now training for national competitions and hope to be champions one day, but my ultimate goal is to be an ice hockey teacher and help people learn to play this game.
ex.t: 现在正在接受全国比赛的训练，希望有一天能成为冠军，但我的最终目标是成为一名冰球老师，帮助人们学习打这场比赛。

ex.s: We all want to hope things will turn out fine.
ex.t: 我们都希望事情最终会好转。
